text: Research is one of my favorite things to do. I feel like I'm# trying to solve a mystery.
source_text:
Research is one of my favorite things to do. I feel like I'm
# trying to solve a mystery.

text: 研究是我最喜欢做的事之一。我喜欢解决各种迷团。
source_text: 研究是我最喜欢做的事之一。我喜欢解决各种迷团。

text: Being a scribe is the best. You get to study all the old# technologies and try to develop new ones.
source_text:
Being a scribe is the best. You get to study all the old
# technologies and try to develop new ones.

text: 做个研究员是最好的。你着手研究所有古代技术并且试图发展新的出来。
source_text: 做个研究员是最好的。你着手研究所有古代技术并且试图发展新的出来。

text: These terminals could use an enhancement.Maybe we should put the display over here.
source_text: These terminals could use an enhancement.Maybe we should put the display over here.

text: 这些终端设备可以改进。也许我们应该把显示器放在这儿。
source_text: 这些终端设备可以改进。也许我们应该把显示器放在这儿。

text: Sorry, I'm right in the middle of a possible breakthrough.# I can't talk right now.
source_text:
Sorry, I'm right in the middle of a possible breakthrough.
# I can't talk right now.

text: 对不起，我现在处在一个可能的突破性成就当中。我现在不能闲谈。
source_text: 对不起，我现在处在一个可能的突破性成就当中。我现在不能闲谈。

text: Hey Initiate. You should train to be a Scribe, if you haven't# decided yet.
source_text:
Hey Initiate. You should train to be a Scribe, if you haven't
# decided yet.

text: 嘿新兵。你应该锻炼去做一个研究员，如果你还没有决定的话。
source_text: 嘿新兵。你应该锻炼去做一个研究员，如果你还没有决定的话。

text: Us Scribes design all the equipment, weapons, and supplies.# It's quite exciting.
source_text:
Us Scribes design all the equipment, weapons, and supplies.
# It's quite exciting.

text: 我们研究员设计所有的装备，武器，和补给。这是十分令人兴奋的。
source_text: 我们研究员设计所有的装备，武器，和补给。这是十分令人兴奋的。

text: Please don't disturb me. I'm trying to finish my research.
source_text: Please don't disturb me. I'm trying to finish my research.

text: 请不要打扰我。我正在尝试完成我的研究。
source_text: 请不要打扰我。我正在尝试完成我的研究。

text: That's Vree right there. She's also a scribe.
source_text: That's Vree right there. She's also a scribe.

text: 那边的那个是弗蕾。她也是一个研究员。
